intro: Extract images from PDF takes the photos, logos and illustrations stored inside a document and gives them to you in a ZIP, each one as a separate file. It is not the same as turning pages into images: no snapshot of the page is taken; instead, the image that was embedded when the PDF was created is recovered at its original resolution.

With the “Original” format, the default, images stored as JPEG are copied byte for byte, without being compressed again, so they lose no quality at all. Images that use other compression schemes are saved as PNG, which loses no information either. If you would rather have them all in the same format, choose PNG or JPG; JPG uses a quality of 90.

In the additional options you can ignore small images such as icons, bullets or ornaments: by default, those less than 32 pixels wide or high are skipped, and you can raise that threshold up to 10,000 or lower it to 0 to keep everything. Duplicates are also removed, so a logo repeated on every page comes out only once; turn this off if you want to keep identical copies that the PDF stores separately. Images inside form XObjects are found too, not just those placed directly on the page.

Each file is named after the page it appears on plus a counter, for example pagina-003-imagen-007.jpg, and if you upload several PDFs the ZIP has one folder per document. When it finishes you will see how many images were extracted and, if any use a codec we cannot read, such as JBIG2, how many were left out.

faq.a: With “Original”, JPEGs come out exactly as they were inside the PDF and the rest are saved as lossless PNG. They are only compressed again if you choose JPG as the format.
They may be smaller than the pixel threshold, they may be vector drawings, which are not images, or they may be 1-bit masks. Lower the threshold to 0 or use PDF to images to capture the whole page.

faq.q: What if the PDF has no images?
faq.a: The task ends with a message saying none were found, instead of handing you an empty ZIP.

faq.q: Where is it processed and what are the limits?
faq.a: On our server in the EU, with your plan's page limit: 100 per PDF without an account, 300 with a free account and 2,000 on Pro. The ZIP is deleted after one hour without an account or after 24 hours with one.
